// why: Node runs this repository by STRIPPING types, which means it checks none of them. Three
signature changes in one afternoon — scoreCase, renderReading, checkQuote — surfaced as
test failures rather than as type errors, and would have surfaced as runtime errors in any
path a test does not cover. This file is what makes `tsc --noEmit` possible; nothing is
ever emitted from it, and the runtime remains node's own stripping.
`erasableSyntaxOnly` is the load-bearing setting: it refuses enums, parameter properties
and namespaces — the constructs node cannot strip — so the typechecker and the runtime
agree about what this repository is allowed to contain. Without it, tsc would happily pass
